Partition entries are parsed from rawprogram XML files

ROM loading progress indicator is shown during folder scan

"Clear ROM" button removes loaded ROM data
ROM files summary shows total size and partition count
Multiple rawprogram*.xml files are merged correctly

node.comment: No additional packages needed - File System Access API is native browser API

interface.name: useTerminalStore.log
interface.signature: log: (level: TerminalLogLevel, message: string, data?: unknown) => void

interface.name: PartitionInfo
interface.signature: interface PartitionInfo { name: string; lun: number; startSector: bigint; size: number; sizeFormatted: string; ... }

constraints.constraint: Core logic files (src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/) must NOT be modified. Use wrapper hooks pattern.
All new stores should follow Zustand pattern with TypeScript interfaces, initial state, and actions.
All user-facing text must use react-i18next useTranslation hook with keys in en.json and vi.json.
Components should use cn() utility from src/lib/utils.ts for className merging.
All operations should log to terminalStore for user feedback and debugging.
File System Access API requires HTTPS and user gesture to trigger. showDirectoryPicker() must be called from user action (button click).
Sparse image detection: Check magic header 0xed26ff3a in first 4 bytes (little-endian).
ROM entries should be stored with FileSystemFileHandle for efficient file access during flash.
Use log levels appropriately: info (scanning), success (loaded), warning (missing files), error (failures).

tests.standards: Testing follows manual verification approach due to WebUSB/File System Access API dependencies. Run `npm run dev` and perform functional testing with real ROM folders. TypeScript compilation serves as primary code quality check.
